resources.string: Matching messages are covered, not deleted. Tap a covered message to reveal it. Matching incoming notifications are suppressed. Rules apply to text and sender names; your outgoing messages remain visible.
One word or phrase per line
Up to 100 literal phrases, 128 characters each. Case insensitive.
Too many phrases or a phrase exceeds 128 characters.
